g1_text: Name: MeetRec (better a new project, separate from the others). Click Create, then select it in the project menu at the top.
g2_text: On the Google Calendar API page click Enable.
g3_text: Click Get started (or Configure consent screen). App name: MeetRec. Support email: your Gmail. Audience: External. Contact email: your Gmail. Agree and click Create.
g4_text: In Audience click Publish app and confirm, so the login does not expire every 7 days. Google verification is not needed: at login you will see "Google hasn't verified this app", click Advanced > Go to MeetRec. Or stay in Testing and add your addresses under Test users, but you will have to log in again every week.
g5_text: In Credentials click + Create credentials > OAuth client ID. Application type: Desktop app. Name: MeetRec. Click Create, then Download JSON (the file is client_secret_….json).
g6_text: Click "Choose the JSON file…" below and select the downloaded file. The browser opens: pick the Google account, confirm the warning (Advanced > Go to MeetRec) and allow reading the calendar. For more Gmail accounts just click + Google again.
g_intro: Google does not allow reading calendars with a simple code: you need your own "OAuth client". You create it once, for free, in about 5 minutes; then "+ Google" adds as many Gmail accounts as you want. Each "Open" button goes to the right page: check at the top of Google Cloud that the MeetRec project is selected.
if_it_is_a_permission_problem_enable: If it is a permission problem, enable MeetRec in Privacy > Microphone and Screen & System Audio Recording, then restart MeetRec.
if_you_quit_the_recording_keeps_going: If you quit, the recording keeps going in the background. Stop it by reopening MeetRec or with `meet stop`.
